newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Mackie says 1996 accounts may be restated.
newsitem.headline: Mackie says 1996 accounts may be restated.

text.p: Mackie International Plc said on Monday that certain matters had come to light since it announced its preliminary results on March 26 which "may or may not lead to a restatement of the accounts for the year ended December 31, 1996".
A further announcement would be made "in due course", Mackie said in a statement.
Shares in Mackie were temporarily suspended at 0630 GMT this morning, at the company's request, pending clarification of the results.
In March, the Belfast-based engineering company announced a pre-tax loss of 0.44 million sterling for the year ended December 31, 1996 compared with a profit of 30.5 million a year earlier.
It also announced the appointment of Sul Sahota as new group chief executive.
